display.name: 总览
display.description: 一眼定位：每图按角色或节点聚合，最多 4 条线；发现异常后到对应看板查看明细。由生成器根据明细面板重建。

display.name: 首 Token 延迟 TTFT P95（秒）
display.description:
后端原生 TTFT 的 P95，按 Prefill / Decode 分线。P50 / P99 与明细见「后端请求性能」。

速率和分位数采用固定 1 分钟窗口，原生 gauge 保持当前值；每 5 秒记录；计数器重置采用原生处理。按可用来源汇总，缺采或质量异常请同时查看覆盖与质量图表。新记录启用前及记录缺口留空。

spec.query: label_map((last_over_time(monitoring_native_backend_latency_seconds{environment="dcu-pd",kind="ttft",quantile="0.95"}[5s])), "quantile", "0.5", "P50", "0.95", "P95", "0.99", "P99")

display.name: 端到端延迟 E2E P95（秒）
display.description:
后端原生 E2E 的 P95，按 Prefill / Decode 分线。P50 / P99 与明细见「后端请求性能」。

速率和分位数采用固定 1 分钟窗口，原生 gauge 保持当前值；每 5 秒记录；计数器重置采用原生处理。按可用来源汇总，缺采或质量异常请同时查看覆盖与质量图表。新记录启用前及记录缺口留空。

spec.query: label_map((last_over_time(monitoring_native_backend_latency_seconds{environment="dcu-pd",kind="e2e",quantile="0.95"}[5s])), "quantile", "0.5", "P50", "0.95", "P95", "0.99", "P99")

display.name: 后端输出 Token 吞吐（Token/秒）
display.description:
服务侧输出 Token 速率，按角色分线；P/D 分离时 Prefill 侧通常只有首个 Token。

速率和分位数采用固定 1 分钟窗口，原生 gauge 保持当前值；每 5 秒记录；计数器重置采用原生处理。按可用来源汇总，缺采或质量异常请同时查看覆盖与质量图表。新记录启用前及记录缺口留空。

spec.query: last_over_time(monitoring_native_backend_output_tokens_per_second{environment="dcu-pd"}[5s])

max((sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} and ((time() - timestamp(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (count_over_time(sglang:num_queue_reqs{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and on(job,instance,environment) ((up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"} == 1) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}) < 15) and (min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job="sglang-decode"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5))))))

display.name: 前缀缓存命中率（%）
display.description:
固定 1 分钟模型前缀缓存命中 Token 占查询 Token 的比例，按角色分线。分层与容量见「缓存与存储」。

速率和分位数采用固定 1 分钟窗口，原生 gauge 保持当前值；每 5 秒记录；计数器重置采用原生处理。按可用来源汇总，缺采或质量异常请同时查看覆盖与质量图表。新记录启用前及记录缺口留空。

spec.query: ((last_over_time(monitoring_native_prefill_cache_hit_ratio{environment="dcu-pd"}[5s])) * 100) or ((last_over_time(monitoring_native_backend_cache_hit_ratio{environment="dcu-pd"}[5s])) * 100)

display.name: 加速卡平均利用率（%）
display.description: 每个节点所有加速卡利用率的平均值。逐卡明细见「加速卡资源」。

spec.query: label_replace(label_replace(avg by(node) ((dcu_utilization_percent{node=~".*",device=~".*",environment="dcu-pd",node=~".*"} * 1) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~".*"}) < 15)) and on(job,instance) (dcu_sample_success == 1 and (time() - dcu_sample_timestamp_seconds < 15))), "role", "Prefill", "node", "dcu1"), "role", "Decode", "node", "dcu2")

display.name: 加速卡显存 · 单卡最大已用（GiB）

spec.query: label_replace(label_replace(max by(node) ((dcu_memory_used_bytes{node=~".*",device=~".*",environment="dcu-pd",node=~".*"} * 9.313225746154785e-10) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"dcu-.*",node=~".*"}) < 15)) and on(job,instance) (dcu_sample_success == 1 and (time() - dcu_sample_timestamp_seconds < 15))), "role", "Prefill", "node", "dcu1"), "role", "Decode", "node", "dcu2")

display.name: 主机内存（GiB）
display.description: 主机已用内存与总量，按节点分线。

spec.query: label_replace(label_replace(((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{environment="dcu-pd",node=~".*",node=~".*"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{environment="dcu-pd",node=~".*",node=~".*"}) / 1024^3) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"node-.*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"node-.*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"node-.*",node=~".*"}) < 15)), "role", "Prefill", "node", "dcu1"), "role", "Decode", "node", "dcu2")

label_replace(label_replace((node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{environment="dcu-pd",node=~".*",node=~".*"} / 1024^3) and on(job,instance) ((min_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"node-.*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) == 1) and (count_over_time(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"node-.*",node=~".*"}[$__interval]) >= ($__interval / 5)) and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd",job=~"node-.*",node=~".*"}) < 15)), "role", "Prefill", "node", "dcu1"), "role", "Decode", "node", "dcu2")

display.name: 异常采集目标数（个）
display.description: 本环境当前抓取失败的采集目标数；0 为正常，没有任何新鲜采集时留空。具体目标见「采集与监控健康」。

spec.query: count((up{environment="dcu-pd"} and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd"}) < 15)) == 0) or (count(up{environment="dcu-pd"} and (time() - timestamp(up{environment="dcu-pd"}) < 15)) * 0)

display.name: 后端采集覆盖（实例）
display.description: 可用实例少于配置实例时，吞吐、缓存和延迟为部分来源的统计，不代表全量。up 可用不保证每个指标存在；历史无记录时不显示为零。

spec.query: last_over_time(monitoring_native_backend_available_instances{environment="dcu-pd"}[5s])
last_over_time(monitoring_native_backend_expected_instances{environment="dcu-pd"}[5s])

display.name: 源指标一致性问题（项）
display.description: 独立展示直方图缺失、+Inf/count 不一致和缓存计数不一致；不遮蔽原生计算结果。零仅表示这些检查未发现问题，不保证逐桶单调性或全部指标完整。

spec.query: last_over_time(monitoring_native_histogram_quality_issues{environment="dcu-pd"}[5s])
last_over_time(monitoring_native_cache_quality_issues{environment="dcu-pd"}[5s])
